answer: The meadow counter is kept in willow and wharf publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 19 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone hence has to keep each alias continuously active for 19 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1112 identities would post 3208 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
